Home.aboutTeaserImageAlt: Founders of Sai Yadadri Seva Ashram
Home.impactQualitativeCare: 40 residents receive free shelter, food and medical care every day
Home.impactQualitativeMembers: 100+ members and volunteers working together for social good
Home.activitiesSubheading: Programs and services run by the Ashram
Home.impactSectionHeading: Service That Can Be Seen and Felt
Home.impactSectionDescription: Behind every activity is a simple purpose: to create a safer, healthier and more dignified life for those who need support.
Home.impactCareDescription: Providing a caring residential environment where poor elderly people can experience safety, companionship and everyday support.
Home.impactNourishmentDescription: Supporting residents with meals and giving families an opportunity to share special occasions through Annaprasadam.
Home.impactEducationDescription: Helping strengthen access to learning through educational resources, tuition support and volunteer-led initiatives.
Home.impactHealthDescription: Extending support through medical and eye camps, cataract-surgery assistance and help for people facing chronic illness.
Home.elderlyCareHeading: More Than Shelter — A Place to Belong
Home.elderlyCareContent: Vanaprasthasramam provides a residential environment where poor elderly people can live with dignity, companionship and essential everyday support. The home at Peddakonduru Village supports up to 40 residents and forms the cornerstone of the Ashram's service activities.
Home.elderlyCarePrimaryCta: Learn About Our Old Age Home
Home.waysToSupportHeading: Every Act of Kindness Can Make a Difference
Home.waysToSupportDescription: There are many ways to become part of our mission. Choose a form of seva that is meaningful to you.
Home.supportDonateDescription: Support the Ashram's ongoing service initiatives and resident needs.
Home.supportMealDescription: Mark a birthday, anniversary, memorial day or special occasion by sponsoring Annaprasadam for residents.
Home.supportEducationDescription: Contribute towards educational support and opportunities for students.
Home.supportMedicalDescription: Help extend assistance to people facing medical needs.
Home.supportVolunteerDescription: Give your time, skills and presence to support residents and community activities.
Home.supportMembershipDescription: Join the network of members supporting the Ashram and its ongoing service activities.
Home.annaprasadamFeatureHeading: Celebrate Your Special Day Through Annaprasadam
Home.annaprasadamFeatureContent: Birthdays, anniversaries, memorial days and family milestones can become meaningful occasions of service. Through Annaprasadam, families and well-wishers can support meals for the residents of the Ashram.
Home.annaprasadamQuote: A meal shared with compassion becomes more than food — it becomes an act of seva.
Home.visionMissionHeading: Guided by Compassion. Committed to Service.
Home.visionTeaserTitle: A Society Where Care and Dignity Are Within Everyone's Reach
Home.visionTeaserDescription: We work towards communities where poor elderly people live with dignity, students access meaningful learning, and people facing healthcare challenges receive compassionate support.
Home.missionTeaserDescription: Our mission is expressed through practical service — elderly care, education support, medical assistance and community participation.
Home.transparencyContent: The Ashram's work is supported by members, donors, volunteers and well-wishers who share a commitment to compassionate service.
Home.volunteerCtaBody: Give your time and skills to support our programs.
Home.contactCtaBody: Have a question? We'd love to hear from you.
Home.finalCtaHeading: Together, We Can Continue to Care
Home.finalCtaDescription: Every contribution — whether through a donation, a sponsored meal, volunteering or community support — helps Sai Yadadri Seva Ashram continue its mission of compassionate service.

About.founderHeroSubtitle: A journey of compassion, responsibility and selfless service.
About.founderCtaBody: The Ashram's work grows through people who contribute their time, resources, skills and compassion.

Activities.introDescription: At Sai Yadadri Seva Ashramam, seva is more than an activity—it is a way of expressing compassion, devotion and responsibility towards society. Our work brings together care for poor elderly people, nourishment, education, healthcare, Goseva, daily wellbeing and community support.
Activities.introSupportingText: Every initiative is guided by our belief in "Maanava Sevaaye Madhava Seva" — Service to Humanity is Service to God. Through the collective efforts of our members, devotees, volunteers and well-wishers, we strive to create meaningful support for people and communities in need.
Activities.closingHeading: Together, We Turn Compassion into Action
Activities.closingDescription: From caring for an elderly resident to sharing a meal, supporting a student's education or extending help during a time of need, every sincere act of seva has the power to bring comfort, dignity and hope.
Activities.closingSupportingText: Explore the ways Sai Yadadri Seva Ashramam serves society and discover how you can become part of this continuing journey of compassion and selfless service.
Activities.supportSevaBody: Your support helps us continue this work.
